_meta.note: Adam's curated GM notes shown in the CR Calculus row (the deliberate-design flags that a re-rate would wrongly 'fix').

notes.ETOILE#0: Designed low-level nemesis (Adam, 2026-10-12): the AC 23 is the puzzle, not a mis-rating — a Tiny, dextrous composition the party must outsmart: restrain it and negate its Dex/size AC before trading blows. Fielded as a straight slugfest it is a whiff-fest.
notes.ASTRAL CONSTRUCT#8: Menu versatility (Adam, 2026-10-12): its 2 Menu C picks (or 4 B / 8 A equivalents) are caster-grade case-by-case flexibility — the printed CR assumes the manifester chose well. Glass saves (6/6/6) are the intended counter-lane.
notes.TARRASQUE#0: Kept at CR 20 (Adam, 2026-10-12): the body says 24; the CR assumes you can prepare. Flightless, rangeless, and dim — denied its charge it is a siege, met in the open it is an extinction. AMENDED: Burrow 10 ft. — it cannot be pinned, and the ground itself is its ambush lane; like an ancient dragon, it is thwarted or driven off, never casually eliminated (regeneration 40). FF letter banked.

notes.FLESHRAKER (Knife Fiend)#0: Kept at CR 3 (Adam, 2026-10-12): where you see immunity to slashing and piercing, read VULNERABILITY TO BLUDGEONING — and ballistic is Tech Ranged PIERCING, so guns are likewise futile. The immunity-reliance IS the creature: the seemingly-unstoppable serial killer of an Urban Arcana Veiled-World hook, solved the moment someone picks up a club. The calculus above is its strategy snapshot.
notes.ALICORN#0: Kept at CR 8 (Adam, 2026-10-12): the save tower (divine grace) is a fortress; the sword arm is not — it outlasts, it does not overwhelm. Not typically a combatant: it flees before fighting unless the party is actually Evil, and otherwise flees and forgives as 'misguided.'
notes.PUPPETEER#1: Controller doctrine (Adam, 2026-10-12): Puppeteer CR 3; a PUPPET fights at the controlled creature's own CR. The composite runs about one band above the host alone: Enthrall is extraordinary contact-domination — dispel does nothing while the tendrils hold — the host's body shields the rider (Host Protection: saves as an attended item), and Hide Mind blanks divination. Freeing the host means pulling the rider, not winning an argument.
